text: How to Short on Margin Trading Short? It's when you sell at a high price then buy at a lower price. In this way you can earn a profit from the price difference. Let's suppose that the BTC price is currently at 10,000 BUSD and you think that it will drop in the future. Log into Binance transfer 10,000 BUSD as collateral from your spot account to your margin account. On the BTC busd trading page under the Cross three Times tab, select Limit Order, click on borrow and input 10,000. Scroll to 100% and click on Margin Sell BTC Once the order is completed, you would have borrowed 2 BTC and sold them at the price of 10,000 busd each. How to earn a profit after several days if the BTC price goes down to 7,000 busd, you will use the repay function and buy 2 BTC at 7,000 busd each. Then the initially borrowed 2 BTC will be refunded with 14,000 busd automatically if the handling fees and interest are ignored. In this case, you would have 16,000 busd in your margin account and earned 6,000 busd which is a 60% profit. How to manage Risk the market may go in the opposite direction. It is recommended to use an oco. One cancels the other order to manage the risk. Select repay input price 7000-109001-09005.2btc Click on Buy BTC. If the BTC price rises to 10,900, a buy stop limit order at $10,905 will be placed and the limit order will be cancelled. If the BTC price goes down to 7,000, a buy autopay limit order at 7,000 will be placed and the Stop Limit order will be cancelled. Here is how you can short on margin trading and manage your risk using the OCO.
